# Qt / PySide 6.8.3 license texts

The `.txt` files in this directory are unmodified copies of the Qt 6.8.3
[`qtbase/LICENSES`](https://github.com/qt/qtbase/tree/v6.8.3/LICENSES) directory.
They include the LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts referenced by the open-source Qt and
PySide distributions, and license texts for Qt's third-party components.

Upstream tag: `v6.8.3`; annotated tag object:
`4606ef4436469d631d8f15f5a312c9af206ecc43`.
PySide's corresponding license directory is
<https://github.com/pyside/pyside-setup/tree/v6.8.3/LICENSES>.

The presence of a license text does not grant a commercial Qt license or mean
that every component uses every license. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and the
upstream source notices for the components actually distributed.
